brokerApiKey.description: Send HOOKFISH_API_KEY for root access, or a named scoped token minted by POST /admin/tokens.

post.summary: Mint a named broker access token
post.description: Creates an expiring named credential for one or more connection folders. Folder paths are canonicalized to `folder/**`. Tokens may delegate only to folders they already hold, within their own dot-delimited name namespace, and may not create a token that outlives them.

scopes.description: Connection folders. Each path is canonicalized to `path/**`.

403.description: The credential cannot perform this administrative action

409.description: The token name is already in use

get.summary: List active broker access token names
get.description: Requires root access. Returns names only; bearer values, scopes, and expiration metadata are never included.

403.description: The credential cannot perform this administrative action

409.description: The token name is already in use

delete.summary: Revoke a named broker access token
delete.description: Requires root access. Deletes the persisted token record, immediately invalidating its bearer credential.

post.summary: Create a consent URL for a connection
post.description: Returns the provider consent URL. Redirect the user there; the broker handles the callback and stores the tokens. Omit `connection_id` to have the broker mint one (`word-word-number`), optionally below `connection_id_prefix`. Each connection id is one provider link.

connection_id.description: Opaque id for this provider link. Omit to auto-generate as `word-word-number` (e.g. `swift-orchid-4821`). Re-pass the same id to reconnect the same link; a different provider on an existing id returns 409.

connection_id_prefix.description: Slash-delimited path below which the broker should mint an id. Use this only when connection_id is omitted.

scopes.description: Scopes requested for this flow. Leave empty to use the provider defaults -- Swagger otherwise prefills a literal ["string"], which would be sent to the provider verbatim.

return_to.description: Absolute post-callback destination. Its origin must appear in Hookfish trustedOrigins.

get.summary: OAuth redirect target (called by the provider, not by your code)
get.description: Register this URL in the provider's developer console, one per provider. Call `GET /providers` for the exact strings this deployment uses -- they depend on the branch and on how the API is reached, so they are not hard-coded here. Authenticated by the single-use `state` parameter rather than the broker API key.
